title: ci: run plugin-sharing's share-grant switch test against live PostgreSQL (OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL) in CI
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyXo4gSy8DJPNz4ANz

Filing gate: ③ a gap the contract review named · Source: fleet (L2 record 7064569198 on #36116, S2; seat 7's call, 2026-11-21 15:04 UTC). Part of #33787.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：第 6 步（#33787）的 PostgreSQL 一致性测试（`shared-record-ids-switch.test.ts`）只有在设置了 `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` 时才跑，CI 里没有任何任务给 plugin-sharing 设这个变量，所以 PR 和 main 上它都被跳过。
- 这一步做什么：让 CI 里已有的 live PG 环境（Temporal Conformance 那一格用的同一个服务）也跑这个测试文件。
- 不做会怎样：以后改到共享读取的 PR，PG 上结果是否和 SQLite 一致，只能靠人手动跑。
- 要你做的：无。

## What is known
- The test file's PG cell is gated on `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` and gets its own schema, dropped afterwards. On #36116 it was run by hand at the landing head (the reading is posted on that PR).
- `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` already starts a PG service, on push only. Whether to add this file to that job or to a new one is this card's call, weighed against the CI time budget.

## Scope
- One CI wiring change that runs this file with the PG URL set, plus a reading of its added time.
- ⛔ No test change. Add no new gate family unless the maintainer names one (SKILL.md: new gates default to no).

## Dedupe
`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL plugin-sharing` → none.

Grade: p3. Type: Task.
